author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The 8BitDo Ultimate 3E ushers in the third generation of their flagship PC/Switch/Xbox controllers. This model takes direct aim at Microsoft's Xbox Elite Series 2 controller, and undercuts it by $50.

Check it out here: https://amzn.to/4gpkK0w
8BitDo Ultimate 3 (lavender): https://amzn.to/4zvNayu
Tablet PC video: https://youtu.be/yodXvO518jE

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
